forex.summary: Foreign-currency markup is 3.5 percent for ePay Amex under the standard IndusInd Premium MITC tier.

base_earn.summary: Points are earned per qualifying transaction of at least ₹500 and post in the next cycle. One to 4 transactions in a statement cycle earn 4 points each. Five to 10 earn 8 points each. More than 10 earn 10 points each. The FAQ caps points per cycle at the credit limit.

conditions.summary: Transactions below ₹500 earn no reward points.

accelerated.summary: If there is at least one qualifying transaction in each of 11 months, the 12th month earns 2X the grid on all spends, which is 8, 16, or 20 points per transaction. Paying the full total amount due within 7 days of the statement earns 5 percent per annum pro-rated cashback. Partial, minimum-due, revolving, and delinquent accounts are ineligible for the early-payment cashback.

redemption.summary: Cash credit is 1 reward point equals ₹0.35. Air miles are 3 reward points equals 1 airmile. Flights and hotels redeem via Indusmoments. InterMiles redemption ended on 21 January 2025.
